desc:
⚓ IDLE PIRATE GAME ⚓
Set sail with nothing and build a pirate empire that runs even when you're offline! Your harbor keeps making berries, your crew keeps watch over your islands, and the sea never stops moving.

🗺️ Take on jobs across East Blue and rank up
🏦 Buy harbor businesses and collect idle income
⚔️ Raid rival pirates and push your bounty higher
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Recruit a crew and gear them with weapons, armor and ships
🍎 Defeat bosses to collect Devil Fruits
🚩 Form a Fleet with friends and conquer islands in Fleet Wars
🏆 Rule the rankings

🎁 CODE AT 500 LIKES! 👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to unlock a free reward!
